transactions.counterparty: PT Abadi Jaya Sakti and PT Tigamitra Ekamulia (related parties of the controlling shareholder of the Manager and controlling Unitholder of First REIT)
transactions.citation: Note 30 (p7595): 'On 4 December 2025, the Group has through its indirect wholly-owned subsidiaries, Lovage International Pte. Ltd. and IAHCC Investment Pte. Ltd, completed the disposal of 100% of issued and paid-up share capital of PT Karya Sentra Sejahtera ("PT KSS") to related parties, PT. Abadi Jaya Sakti and PT. Tigamitra Ekamulia, for a total sales consideration (net of tax) of $22,440,000.' Interested Person Transactions table (p7698): 'PT Abadi Jaya Sakti and PT Tigamitra Ekamulia - Sales consideration for the divestment of 100% issued and paid-up share capital of PT Karya Sentra Sejahtera | S$25,908,000'. Portfolio Statement (p5462): Imperial Aryaduta Hotel & Country Club fair value/valuation column shows 27,723 (FY2024, S$'000) and '-' for FY2025 (disposed).
transactions.notes: No independent deal valuation is disclosed for this transaction; gain_loss_pct is DERIVED against the last disclosed portfolio-statement fair value (S$27,723,000, as at 31 Dec 2024 -- the FY2025 column shows '-' since the property/subsidiary was derecognised on disposal) using the GROSS sales consideration of S$25,908,000 disclosed in the Interested Person Transactions table: (25,908-27,723)/27,723*100 = -6.55%. This is distinct from three other disclosed figures that must NOT be conflated: (1) the $22,440,000 'total sales consideration (net of tax)' in Note 30, which is net of Indonesian withholding tax of $1,105,000 deducted from the gross $25,908,000 price minus transaction costs, not a market discount; (2) the carrying amount of net assets disposed of $25,627,000 (Note 30 reconciliation), a book-value figure for the disposed subsidiary's net assets, different from the property's own fair value of $27,723,000; (3) the accounting loss on disposal of -$7,535,000 recognised in profit or loss, which additionally reflects realisation of a $5,193,000 cumulative foreign-exchange translation reserve plus $130,000 cash transaction costs plus $130,000 Manager's divestment fee (paid in units) plus the $1,105,000 withholding tax -- a -29.4% loss against the $25,627,000 net-assets carrying amount, but this bundled figure is not a clean price-vs-reference premium/discount and was not used for gain_loss_pct. Divestment effected via a 100% share-capital sale of the property-holding subsidiary PT Karya Sentra Sejahtera; interest_pct left null as the full 100% interest was sold.
